name: Arsenal
headline: Who would you rather watch the match with?
subline: Pick your matchday companion. The Gooners decide the ranking.

cards.name: Thierry Henry
cards.tagline: 228 goals, and he still explains where the space was.

cards.name: Dennis Bergkamp
cards.tagline: Says nothing for 80 minutes, then the one perfect observation.

cards.name: Tony Adams
cards.tagline: Never sits down and will not let you either.

cards.name: Ian Wright
cards.tagline: Celebrates every goal like he scored it, and every win like a title.

cards.name: Patrick Vieira
cards.tagline: Takes charge of the room and the seating plan.

cards.name: Robert Pires
cards.tagline: Elegant, calm, and always right about the pass.

cards.name: David Seaman
cards.tagline: Safe hands, calm head, and never drops your pint.

cards.name: Freddie Ljungberg
cards.tagline: Wild hair, wild celebrations, loudest in the room.

cards.name: Ray Parlour
cards.tagline: Local lad, loud, and always ready for a long shot.

cards.name: Bukayo Saka
cards.tagline: Smiles through everything and has the whole pub smiling.

cards.name: Arsene Wenger
cards.tagline: Tells you calmly that you did not see the tackle.

cards.name: Herbert Chapman
cards.tagline: Arrives with a tactics board and a plan for the next ten years.

cards.name: George Graham
cards.tagline: Wants a clean sheet and silence until the final whistle.

cards.name: Mikel Arteta
cards.tagline: Cannot stay in his seat and will not stop gesturing.

cards.name: Harry Bradshaw
cards.tagline: Laid the foundations a century ago and wants the credit.

cards.name: Bertie Mee
cards.tagline: Started as the physio, so he asks who is injured first.

cards.name: Terry Neill
cards.tagline: Believes in the comeback until the final second.

cards.name: George Allison
cards.tagline: Steady hand, calm voice, never rattled.

cards.name: Unai Emery
cards.tagline: Has a plan for everything and a spreadsheet for the rest.

cards.name: Daniel Kaluuya
cards.tagline: Narrates the whole match, and it sounds like a documentary.

cards.name: Idris Elba
cards.tagline: Brings the sound system and the strong opinions.

cards.name: Lewis Hamilton
cards.tagline: Wants the fastest possible counter-attack.

cards.name: Colin Firth
cards.tagline: Lives every last-minute goal as if it were Fever Pitch.

cards.name: Dua Lipa
cards.tagline: Dances through every goal.

cards.name: Mick Jagger
cards.tagline: Makes the whole stand feel like a stadium gig.

cards.name: Jamie Foxx
cards.tagline: Starts a chant, then keeps going for 90 minutes.

cards.name: Jay-Z
cards.tagline: Arrives late, takes the best seat, and stays very calm.

cards.name: Rihanna
cards.tagline: Fashion first, football second, and the whole row is watching her.

cards.name: Piers Morgan
cards.tagline: Argues with everyone on the timeline in real time.
